rows.note: Use 意味住 as the all-purpose choice when one thing signifies or logically implies another.

example.english: The way they put it can connote that the matter is not over yet.
example.traditional: 佢咁樣講，意味住件事仲未完。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 joeng2 gong2 ji3 mei6 zyu6 gin6 si6 zung6 mei6 jyun4

rows.note: Choose 暗示 when the meaning is hinted at indirectly rather than stated openly or entailed logically.

example.english: Their sudden question about whether I was free can connote that they want to ask me to dinner.
example.traditional: 佢突然問我得唔得閒，暗示住想約我食飯。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dat6 jin4 man6 ngo5 dak1 m4 dak1 haan4 am3 si6 zyu6 soeng2 joek3 ngo5 sik6 faan6

rows.jyutping: A ling6 jan4 lyun4 soeng2 dou3 B
rows.note: Use this when something evokes an association or underlying idea, rather than simply stating what it means.

example.english: This song can connote the days when we were growing up.
example.traditional: 呢首歌令人聯想到我哋細個嗰段日子。
example.jyutping: ne1 sau2 go1 ling6 jan4 lyun4 soeng2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 sai3 go3 go2 dyun6 jat6 zi2
